•	 Other cooked fish and seafood may be eaten, up to 12 oz/week. 
See Focus On: Omega-3 Fatty Acids in Pregnancy and Lactation for 
recommended choices.
•	 Avoid refrigerated seafood products unless cooked before eating 
(165° F).
•	 Avoid raw or undercooked fish and seafood, including sushi and shell-
fish. All fish and shellfish should be cooked to 145° F.
•	 Observe local advisories regarding mercury and other contaminants. (For 
access to your state’s or territory’s advisories, see: http://fishadvisoryonline.
epa.gov/General.aspx. Accessed October 2015.)
